# Bobine

> Bobine is free software (AGPL-3.0) that plays and schedules videos and music on the screens and speakers of a gym or fitness studio. It runs on a local machine and works offline: no account, no subscription, no cloud service.

## Facts
- Name: Bobine. Website: https://bobine.fit
- Author: Clément Barillot (FantasmaGlad). Contact: clement.barillot@bobine.fit
- License: AGPL-3.0. Source: https://github.com/FantasmaGlad/Bobine
- Current versions (Stable, Beta, Canary): https://bobine.fit/latest.json
- Stack: Python and FastAPI, SQLite, Next.js, mpv. Local web interface on port 1903.
- Internet is needed to download and update, not to play.

## Platforms
- Windows 10 or 11, x86-64 or ARM64
- macOS on Apple Silicon
- Linux x86-64 or ARM64: .deb, .rpm and pacman packages, signed repositories at https://packages.bobine.fit
- Android 14 or later, Android TV and Google TV
- Dedicated Debian machine (kiosk, starts at boot): `curl -fsSL https://bobine.fit/install.sh | sudo bash`

## Features
- Weekly schedule that starts classes on time
- Video output on the wired screen and on other screens of the local network
- Background radio with crossfade and voice reminders
- Touch kiosk for members, phone remote over local Wi-Fi
- Subtitles (SRT, WebVTT) and chapters
- Updates on three channels: Stable, Beta, Canary
